description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'NoteModal' used for creating and editing notes within a note management system. It includes a template with UI elements, reactive state management, methods for handling user actions like save and cancel, and input handling logic.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the note input fields and emits a 'save' event with the note data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Emits a 'cancel' event to close the modal without saving.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets the focus to the title input field.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets the focus to the content input field.
